verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key and HSM product line, and its documented features (FIDO2, OpenPGP, PIV, OTP, on-device keygen, encrypted mobile storage) all keep data on the physical device. It offers no hosted or cloud storage service, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a cloud-hosted data service that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
